instruction: Browse the FlightAware discussion forums and locate the 'General Aviation' category, then open any discussion thread within it.

metadata.explanation: Variation requires navigating to General Aviation category in discussions and opening a thread. Uses regex pattern matching with '.+' to verify URL contains additional path segments beyond the category, ensuring a thread was opened rather than just the category page.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction verification: The evaluator correctly verifies both requirements of the instruction: (1) navigating to the General Aviation category, and (2) opening a discussion thread within it.

Correct regex pattern: The pattern 'https://discussions\.flightaware\.com/c/general-aviation/.+' uses '.+' which requires ONE OR MORE additional characters after '/c/general-aviation/'. This ensures the URL has additional path segments beyond the category path.

Proper thread verification: The regex will match thread URLs (e.g., 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/c/general-aviation/123/thread-title') but will NOT match the category page alone (e.g., 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/c/general-aviation/') because the trailing slash is followed by nothing, not matching '.+'.

Semantic correctness: The getter (active_tab_info) extracts the active tab URL, and the metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) performs regex matching. The data flow is correct and the logic will work at runtime.
